ctx.x: From then on, you just played trumpet?

From then on, I started playing trumpet. Yeah. Then on, I started playing trumpet. And I played there about, I don't think about a year or two, or a year and a half. And that's, Godet, he gets out of a job, and he did a rule two falls on. And he's good, he put it in front of mine. We both want to know each other how to read. So, uh, he gets out of a job.
